release.label: representation.identifier.alphanumeric_id
release.why: The relationship tables' release, the month and year ONS gives in the workbook's name, 2021-07: an identifier for the snapshot, stored as text as every release is. Inferred, finetype labels it a year and month and the descriptor would type the column as a date.
